source: 人教版2019选择性必修三 Unit 5 同主题完形(我写第一首诗/俳句课/诗歌朗诵会/读懂一首诗/诗歌比赛/民谣到诗)。用词限 U5/初中/常见词,答案唯一,4选项同词性,与阅读关不撞文章。答案位稍后打散。

passages.title: My First Poem
passages.text: Last term our teacher asked each of us to (1)____ a short poem of our own. At first I thought it would be (2)____, because I was only an amateur and had never tried before. She told me to start with a (3)____ that mattered to me, and then to make a list of the words I wanted to (4)____. I chose my little brother, who is always (5)____ me and laughing. Slowly the lines came together, and I felt a quiet (6)____ of joy. When I read the poem (7)____, I could hear that two of the lines (8)____ nicely. My teacher said the (9)____ of the words sounded just like a song. That was the day (10)____ I first fell in love with writing poetry.

questions.explanation: write a poem 写诗;其余动词不搭。
thought it would be difficult 觉得会很难。
start with a theme 从主题开始。
words I wanted to use 想用的词。
always teasing me 总是逗弄我。
a feeling of joy 一种喜悦之情。
read the poem aloud 大声朗读。
the lines rhymed 诗行押韵。
the rhythm of the words 词语的节奏。
the day when 时间先行词、从句完整 → when。

passages.title: A Lesson on the Haiku
passages.text: Today our English class learned about a Japanese (1)____ called the haiku. Our teacher explained that it has just seventeen (2)____, set out in three short lines. The three lines hold five, seven and five sounds (3)____. Although it is very (4)____, a haiku can still paint a clear picture in the reader's mind. She showed us one (5)____ about a fallen blossom drifting back towards its branch, and another about a (6)____ butterfly resting in the sun. With so (7)____ words, the poet still creates a special (8)____. We then tried to (9)____ our own haiku about the rain outside the window. It was harder than it looked, but by the end of the lesson everyone had (10)____ a tiny poem of their own.

questions.explanation: a Japanese form 一种日本诗体;同为名词。
seventeen syllables 十七个音节。
five, seven and five respectively 依次为。
very short 很短。
showed us one haiku 给我们看一首俳句。
a delicate butterfly 一只脆弱的蝴蝶。
so few words 这么少的词。
a special mood 一种特别的情绪。
write our own haiku 写自己的俳句。
had created a tiny poem 创作了一首小诗。

passages.title: The Poetry Evening
passages.text: Every spring our school holds a poetry evening (1)____ students read their favourite poems aloud. This year I chose a poem (2)____ I had loved since I was a child. Before the show, I practised many times so that I could (3)____ every line clearly and with feeling. My hands were shaking, for I am only an (4)____, not a real poet. But my teacher smiled and told me to find the (5)____ of the words and let my voice follow it. When my turn came, I took a deep breath and began to (6)____. To my surprise, the room fell silent, (7)____ made me feel proud. People said the poem's gentle (8)____ moved them almost to tears. That evening I learned that a poem comes truly (9)____ only when it is read aloud. I will never forget the moment (10)____ the whole audience clapped for me.

questions.explanation: the evening where 地点(场合)、从句完整 → where。
a poem that I had loved 指物缺宾语 → that。
recite every line 吟诵每一行。
only an amateur 只是个业余爱好者。
the rhythm of the words 词语的节奏。
began to read 开始朗读。
非限制性 which 指代前句 → which。
the poem's gentle mood 诗温柔的情绪。
comes alive 鲜活起来。
the moment when 时间先行词、从句完整 → when。

passages.title: Reading a Poem Slowly
passages.text: Many readers give up on poetry because they read it too (1)____. A poem is not like a story; it asks you to slow down and (2)____ each picture it paints. First, look for the main (3)____ that the poet places in your mind. Next, ask yourself what (4)____ the poet wants to share, whether it is happy or sad. The sounds and rhymes give a poem a musical (5)____, so it is best to read it (6)____. If you meet a word you do not know, do not (7)____; the picture and the sound often help you guess its meaning. Read the same poem more than (8)____, for each time usually brings something new. Little by little you will begin to (9)____ how beautiful a few simple lines can be. Then poetry will no longer feel (10)____ to you at all.

questions.explanation: read it too fast 读得太快。
imagine each picture 想象每个画面。
the main image 主要意象。
what feeling 什么感受。
a musical quality 音乐般的特质。
read it aloud 大声朗读。
do not worry 不要担心。
more than once 不止一次。
appreciate how beautiful 欣赏其美。
feel strange 感到陌生。

passages.title: Entering the Poetry Contest
passages.text: Our teacher told us about a poetry (1)____ that the city was holding for young writers. The (2)____ for sending in our work was the end of the month, so we had to hurry. Nora said she still needed time to (3)____ her writing, because her first lines did not yet sound right. Pitt did not want to (4)____ at all, for he thought his poems were too simple. But the teacher said that even an (5)____ can win if the feeling is true. George planned to (6)____ a poem about his grandmother, (7)____ had taught him many old songs. He chose his words with care so that the lines would (8)____ and flow like music. On the last day, he read his poem (9)____ to the class, and everyone clapped. He did not win first prize, but he felt proud of the (10)____ he had created.

questions.explanation: a poetry contest 诗歌比赛。
the deadline 截止日期。
polish her writing 润色作品。
did not want to enter 不想参赛。
even an amateur 即便业余爱好者。
write a poem 写一首诗。
非限制性、指人(grandmother)作主语 → who。
the lines would rhyme 诗行押韵。
read his poem aloud 大声朗读。
the poem he had created 他创作的诗。

passages.title: From Songs to Poems
passages.text: Long ago, before books or films existed, people made up simple songs about their daily (1)____. They sang about hunting in the forest or (2)____ crops in the fields. Because nothing was written down, the songs were passed on by (3)____, and over the years many (4)____ of them grew up. Each region slowly formed its own special (5)____ and tune. People also liked to tell long stories about past heroes, (6)____ they gave rhyme so that the words were easier to (7)____. At first these songs were very simple, but in time they became more (8)____ and more polished. They were no longer the work of villagers around a (9)____, but of true poets who cared deeply about their (10)____. In this way, music slowly turned into the poetry we know today.

questions.explanation: daily lives 日常生活。
sowing crops 播种庄稼。
passed on by mouth 口口相传。
many variations 许多变体。
its own special rhythm 自己的节奏。
so they gave rhyme 因此加上押韵(表结果)。
easier to remember 更易记住。
more complicated 更复杂。
around a fire 围着火堆。
cared about their art 在意他们的艺术。
